options.name: api_app
options.description: The app portion of the Splunk API path for the findings endpoint. Override this if your environment uses a different app name.

options.name: api_namespace
options.description: The namespace portion of the Splunk API path. Override this if your environment uses a different namespace.

options.name: api_user
options.description: The user portion of the Splunk API path. Override this if your environment requires a different user context.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the finding. Required when creating a new finding.

options.name: disposition
options.description: Disposition of the finding. Can be updated on existing findings.

options.name: entity
options.description: The risk object (entity) associated with the finding. Required when creating a new finding.

options.name: entity_type
options.description: The type of the risk object (entity). Required when creating a new finding.

options.name: fields
options.description: List of custom fields to add to the finding. Only used when creating new findings.

options.name: finding_score
options.description: The risk score for the finding. Required when creating a new finding.

options.name: owner
options.description: Owner of the finding. Use C(admin) for the administrator user. Use C(unassigned) to leave the finding unassigned. Can be updated on existing findings.

options.name: ref_id
options.description: Reference ID (finding ID / event_id) of an existing finding. Format is typically C(uuid@@notable@@time{timestamp}) (e.g., C(2008e99d-af14-4fec-89da-b9b17a81820a@@notable@@time1768225865)). If provided, the module will verify the finding exists and update it. If not provided, a new finding is created. When updating, only C(owner), C(status), C(urgency), and C(disposition) can be modified.

options.name: security_domain
options.description: Security domain for the finding. Required when creating a new finding.

options.name: status
options.description: Status of the finding. Can be updated on existing findings.

options.name: title
options.description: Title of the finding. Required when creating a new finding (without C(ref_id)).

options.name: urgency
options.description: Urgency level of the finding. Can be updated on existing findings.
